claims.quote: Heterandria formosa originates from Florida and neighbouring states of the USA.

It is commonly found throughout the south-eastern United States, from at least as far west as the western Mississippi river drainage in West Baton Rouge Parish, Louisiana, throughout the Florida peninsula, and as far north as the Cape Fear River, North Carolina.
The least killifish, Heterandria formosa, is a tiny livebearer from the United States, found in heavily vegetated margins of still or sluggish water.
